reviews.text:
A wonderful discovery at Toutou Chic!

A warm welcome, a lovely team, and above all, remarkable work. The haircut is exactly as I wanted for my little Hermès!

I am truly delighted with the result and the team's professionalism. It's a real pleasure to entrust my little companion to such caring and passionate people.

I wholeheartedly recommend Toutou Chic and will definitely be back!

An excellent experience at Toutou Chic! Blandine took perfect care of my little Nala, who was groomed with great care and gentleness. She was truly pampered, and the result is magnificent: I am absolutely delighted!

You can immediately feel the professionalism, passion, and attention to the well-being of the animals. Nala was in very good hands, and that was truly wonderful.

I will definitely be back in a few months. I highly recommend Toutou Chic to all owners who want to give their companion a quality grooming experience!

I love this salon! I've had them take care of my little Bichon Frise four times now!

Each time he leaves with a new haircut! I feel like he gets younger with every appointment.

The team is friendly, the owner is charming and pleasant, and the salon itself is truly beautiful.
Thank you so much for your 4-star rating! We look forward to seeing you again at Toutou Chic Paris 16 for your next pet care appointment. The Toutou Chic Paris 16 Team

Toutou Chic, always the best! Why change a winning team? A huge thank you to Clémentine for her kindness, professionalism, and love of animals. Our dog always leaves looking beautiful and happy. See you soon!
Fantastic find! My dog ​​was happy and pampered for 2.5 hours! I'll be back more often! Thank you so much, Toutou Chic!
My dog ​​and I received a very warm welcome from the owner and two groomers, including Clémence who took care of my furry friend. Excellent value for money for an hour of grooming! We'll be back ♥️
Second visit to the grooming salon, after trying the one in the 17th arrondissement, my golden retriever came out looking as handsome and clean as ever. Thank you for the welcome gifts.
Frida has regained all her glamour — a big thank you to Jordan and his team!
